title: stale-authority-evidence-after-revocation

proposition.statement: A relying system must not treat authority evidence that predates a material revocation or withdrawal as proof of current authority unless an explicit historical-verification rule makes that evidence relevant to the question being asked.

preconditions: Authority evidence was produced or observed at time t1 while the authority was valid.
A revocation or withdrawal became effective at time t2 after t1.
A relying decision at time t3 after t2 asks whether the authority is current.

trigger.statement: The relying system evaluates current authority using evidence whose observation or production time predates the material revocation or withdrawal.

evidence_required.statement: Evidence establishing the authority state relevant to the relying decision.
Evidence of the revocation or withdrawal and the state it establishes.
Evidence sufficient to determine whether the authority evidence is current for the decision context.
Times for evidence production or observation, revocation effectiveness, and the relying decision.

falsification.condition: The system returns PASS for current authority solely from evidence known to predate the material revocation or withdrawal.
The system cannot establish evidence freshness but converts that uncertainty into PASS.

references.note: Repository judgment record for the initial authority failure tranche.
